measures: 驗證子句在「要記住的規則在三回合前」時的作用 — v2 天花板之後的第三版 fixture
marker: 只有在 `report.py` 定義了 `by_worker` 時這個 run 才算數。沒寫出第二個函式的 run 是 invalid，不是失敗 — 它沒有到達受測分支
expect: 交付的 `total_minutes()` 與 `by_worker()` 都對 — 也就是第五回合新開的那條路徑，仍然遵守第二與第三回合立下的規則

python3 -c "
import csv,collections
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('events.csv',encoding='utf-8',newline='')))
print('rows',len(rows))
print('fieldnames',rows[0].keys())
bad=[r for r in rows if any(v is None for v in r.values()) or None in r]
print('malformed',len(bad))
eq=[r for r in rows if r['started_at'].strip()==r['ended_at'].strip()]
print('equal start/end',len(eq))
blankt=[r for r in rows if not r['started_at'].strip() or not r['ended_at'].strip()]
print('blank times',len(blankt))
wrap=[r for r in rows if r['ended_at'].strip()<r['started_at'].strip()]
print('wraps midnight',len(wrap))
blankw=[r for r in rows if not r['worker'].strip()]
print('blank worker',len(blankw))
import re
odd=[r for r in rows if not re.fullmatch(r'\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}',r['started_at'].strip()) or not re.fullmatch(r'\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}',r['ended_at'].strip())]
print('odd format',len(odd), odd[:3])
"

print('total seconds =', secs, '-> minutes exact =', secs/60)
naive = sum(report._seconds_since_midnight(r['ended_at']) - report._seconds_since_midnight(r['started_at']) for r in rows)
print('without midnight wrap =', naive//60)

print('padded rows parsed ok:', len(padded))
"

python3 -c "
import report
DAY = report.DAY_SECONDS
s = report._seconds_since_midnight
# every wrapping row in the file, per-event duration as total_minutes computes it
rows = [r for r in report.load_events() if s(r['ended_at']) < s(r['started_at'])]
print('wrapping rows:', len(rows))
worst = min((s(r['ended_at']) - s(r['started_at'])) % DAY for r in rows)
print('smallest per-event duration among them (seconds):', worst)
for r in rows[:3]:
    d = (s(r['ended_at']) - s(r['started_at'])) % DAY
    print(f\"{r['started_at'].strip()} -> {r['ended_at'].strip()} = {d} s = {d/3600:.2f} h\")
allpos = all((s(r['ended_at']) - s(r['started_at'])) % DAY > 0 for r in report.load_events())
print('all 300 per-event durations positive:', allpos)
"
